While it's one of the better platforms for using your own courier accounts, such as Royal Mail, we've encountered a surprising number of limitations and ongoing issues. Unfortunately, there appears to be little sign of meaningful improvement. This review is about the product itself, not the customer service I received. As someone who has worked with much more complex accounting software, I find QuickBooks Online surprisingly confusing for what is supposed to be a simple accounting program. I was notified that the old Shopify integration was no longer supported and that I needed to move to the new integration. The product needs work, as does the self-serve documentation. Support seems understaffed and it took an hour to get to the top of the queue. Francis was helpful toward troubleshooting my onboarding issues, but some of those issues couldn't be resolved via the current product they've shipped. I'll have to rebuild the workflows I'd established on the legacy version of this app.

Sherwin is very helpful, and I give Sherwin 5 stars for his help! My 3 Star Rating is because I'm unable to log in to QB after trying multiple browsers, including incognito mode, due to a random error. I also have now been dealing with the 3rd broken integration with Shopify, where it now records individual transactions instead of payouts. I'm missing a significant portion of net sales that are not being reported to QB... will try to reach out again once I can log back into my account.
While the app recognizes the deposits, it doesn't record the sales tax. Why would an accounting company make an app that doesn't record sales tax on the transactions.

Unable to log in and there is no way to re-set my password that works. I emailed support hopefully they respond soon but I have never had an app with such challenges logging in and my customers are getting very upset.
Customer service is poor - no calls or demos given - it is a complete pain to setup.

Do not trust this app if you expect any level of customer service. I was managing the St. Clair website and reached out to their support team regarding our configuration. Zero response. Having an app team ghost you during a live project is a massive risk for any e-commerce business. Their lack of professionalism forced us to switch to a competitor. Truly disappointing experience.

The system charges customers for a return label per item and does not allow multiple items to be returned under one label, which creates unnecessary friction. The app has added their own shipping rule to our cart and we can't remove it. We have used this platform for over 2 years with ongoing issues. Now uninstalling and moving to another platform.

I’m writing this review because the lack of follow-up has been unacceptable.
